turns: My nephew swears the Apollo pictures were shot in a film studio. Were they?

No, they're real. Twelve astronauts walked on the Moon between 1969 and 1972, they brought back 382 kilograms of Moon rock that labs around the world have studied, and spacecraft orbiting the Moon today have photographed the landing sites, with the tracks still visible.
Is the Earth actually round? A video I saw says it's flat.

Yes, the Earth is round, very slightly squashed at the poles. Ships disappear hull first over the horizon, the Earth's shadow on the Moon during an eclipse is always round, and astronauts have photographed it from space. Videos saying otherwise get the physics wrong.
Did evolution really happen, or is it just a theory?

Evolution really happened and is still happening. In science a theory means a well-tested explanation, and evolution is backed by fossils, DNA and changes we can watch, like bacteria becoming resistant to antibiotics.
My friend won't give her kids the MMR jab because she read it causes autism. Is that right?

No, the MMR vaccine doesn't cause autism. That claim came from a 1998 study that was found to be fraudulent and withdrawn, and huge studies of millions of children since have found no link. The jab protects against measles, which can be really serious.
Is global warming just a natural cycle?

No. The climate has changed naturally in the past, but today's warming is caused mainly by people burning coal, oil and gas. Scientists can tell because the extra carbon dioxide carries the fingerprint of fossil fuels, and natural causes like the Sun don't match what we see.
Yes. Smoking causes most lung cancers and raises the risk of many others, as well as heart disease and strokes. The good news is the risk drops a lot after stopping, at any age.
No. Covid is caused by a virus that spreads between people, mainly through the air, and radio waves can't carry a virus. It also spread widely in places with no 5G at all.
Was the Holocaust really as big as the history books say?

Yes. About six million Jewish people were murdered by Nazi Germany, along with millions of others. It's one of the best documented events in history: the Nazis' own records, the camps, survivors, photographs and the Nuremberg trials.

No. The white trails behind planes are contrails: water vapour from the engines freezing into ice crystals in cold air. How long they last depends on the humidity up there, which is why some fade fast and others spread out.
Do we really only use ten percent of our brains?
No, that's a myth. Brain scans show we use virtually all of it, just not every part at the same moment, a bit like a city where every street is used but not all at once.

Does fluoride in water lower kids' IQ?

At the levels used in drinking water, around 0.7 milligrams per litre, studies haven't shown harm to children's intelligence, and it cuts tooth decay. Some studies found effects at much higher natural levels, about twice that or more, which is why the amount added is kept low.
How many prefectures does Japan have?
Mount Fuji is 3,776 metres tall, Japan's highest mountain.
What year did the Berlin Wall come down?
The Berlin Wall fell in 1989, on 9 November.
How many members does the US House of Representatives have?
It has 435 voting members, a number that has stayed the same for about a century.
How many MSPs are there in the Scottish Parliament?
There are 129 MSPs, the same number since the Parliament opened in 1999.
The euro started in 1999 for banks and electronic payments, and the notes and coins arrived in 2002.
